name: Lyndon B. Johnson
role: President of the United States (1963–69); announced the agreement and hosted the Washington signing

name: Arthur J. Goldberg
role: US Ambassador to the UN (1965–68); led US negotiation of the treaty

name: Platon D. Morozov
role: Soviet representative in the 1966 Legal Subcommittee talks

name: Andrei A. Gromyko
role: Soviet Foreign Minister; signed in Moscow

name: Alexei N. Kosygin
role: Chairman of the USSR Council of Ministers; attended the Moscow signing

name: Valerian A. Zorin
role: Soviet Deputy Foreign Minister and UN representative

name: Franz Matsch
role: Austrian diplomat; chaired the UN Outer Space Committee

name: William R. Frye
role: UN correspondent whose dispatch ran in the Evening Star, 22 Nov 1963
